## Summary

Describe what this change does and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `golangci-lint run` are clean
- [ ] The frozen conformance vectors are unchanged, or the canonicalization version was bumped intentionally
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or `.env` files are included
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO): `git commit -s`

## Notes for reviewers

Anything that needs special attention, context, or follow-up.
